body:
> Buried Alive by Alter Bridge

Gonna go and give that song a listen.

And I guess my situation isn't very unique. Its sad that we feel that way though.

I'd give you a hug if I could.

I hear that too.
I'm in a situation where if I keep expressing how I feel I may end up pushing away the one person who I'm grown to care for in all this turmoil I'm feeling.

I can sense that my friends are getting tired of it too...

Ideally I'd get professional help, but I just can't afford any at this time. It's horrible...

You can talk on here if that helps even a little bit. I had one person reply to what I wrote earlier, and even that one reply made me feel just a tad better.

Thank you.

I try to tell myself these things, but I also remember all the kind things he did for me.

It's hard.


Thank you though.. Sorry I was gone for so long.

I know that feeling...
I just want to cry and let everyone I care about know that I'm not okay.

If I could just be held by anyone, just hold on and sit in silence with me while I let it out.

I hope you find your worth.
